item.text: The failure mechanism is confirmed: `SpooledTemporaryFile.write()` performs the rollover synchronously after the write, so checking only `_rolled` is too late. I’ll cache its spool limit and predict rollover from the current position plus pending byte count; already-rolled files will continue using the thread pool.

The implementation and a focused regression test are in place. The test checks both boundary behaviors: a write exactly at the limit stays synchronous/in-memory, while the next write is dispatched before it rolls to disk. I’m running formatting, type, and test checks now.
